title: Archive Shade
text: Archive Shade unfolds from a ruined record vault and erases the difference between warning and memory. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Every missing page still casts a shadow.

defeatReward.text: Archive Shade is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
